title: Common feed options
description: Runtime options every driver accepts alongside its own configuration.

staleWarnSec.title: Stale warning (s)
staleWarnSec.description: Health turns to warn when no report has arrived for this long.

staleCriticalSec.title: Stale critical (s)
staleCriticalSec.description: Health turns to critical when no report has arrived for this long.

pinnedReplica.title: Pinned replica
pinnedReplica.description: Run this feed only on the named ingest replica. Optional: a connection that listens on a port runs on a listener replica by default.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Stamped on every observation this feed emits unless the decoder reports a higher level. Entities keep the highest level any feed reported.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Narrows a driver that can do both to one way; cannot widen a driver's own direction.

policy.title: Sharing policy
policy.description: What an outbound connection may send. Every filter is optional; an empty list means no restriction.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.description: Only entities that one of these feeds contributed to.

boxes.title: Areas
boxes.description: Only entities inside one of these boxes; west > east wraps the antimeridian.

classificationCeiling.title: Classification ceiling
classificationCeiling.description: Entities and alerts above this level are never sent.

reexport.title: Re-export
reexport.description: Also send entities that another outbound connection contributed to (loops back to this connection are always prevented).

queueMax.title: Queue size
queueMax.description: Pending updates kept per connection; the oldest position update is dropped beyond it.

perEntityMinSec.title: Min seconds between updates per entity

maxLagSec.title: Max lag (s)
maxLagSec.description: Events older than this when delivered are dropped instead of replayed.

policyExitGraceSec.title: Policy exit grace (s)
policyExitGraceSec.description: How long an entity must stay outside the policy before the remote is told to drop it.
